title: Nimos, brother of Rabbi Yehoshua HaGarsi
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Nimos, brother of Rabbi Yehoshua HaGarsi. Yehoshua was Rabbi Akiva’s attendant.
Mentioned in Tosefta Makhshirin, chapter 3, and Bekhorot 10b: Rabbi Yose said, “Nimos, brother of Rabbi Yehoshua HaGarsi, told me that one who slaughters a raven,” etc.

notes.text: The William Davidson vocalized text of Bekhorot 10b calls Nimos the brother of Rabbi Yehoshua HaGarsi. Eruvin 21b explicitly names Yehoshua HaGarsi as Rabbi Akiva’s attendant, supporting that attachment of the heading’s parenthetical. The raven quotation remains abbreviated with “etc.”
The consulted Tosefta has the forms Inumos and Yehoshua HaBarsi. Bekhorot gives Nimos and Yehoshua HaGarsi. The Eruvin prison episode identifies Yehoshua as Akiva’s attendant.
